titulo: The page turned to face them
caption:
The page turned to face them

"I can't read it." "Turn it around." The page spun to face them, and the plan finally had a right way up.

A page shown upside down explains nothing, and turning it toward them takes a second.

For whoever turns the page around so they can read it.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and a sheet of paper standing upside down on the right, with the word plan upside down on it. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says I can't read it. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers turn it around, and the page spins to face them with the word plan the right way up and a small sparkle above. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...oh. now I see. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me turning it to face them.
